title: santifer/career-ops
claim: santifer/career-ops — Open-source AI job search: scan job portals, evaluate listings with a structured A-F rubric into a 1.0-5.0 score, tailor
why_good: career-ops turns any AI coding CLI into a job search command center: it scans job portals (Greenhouse, Ashby, Lever, company pages), evaluates each listing with a structured A-F rubric across 5 weighted dimensions plus a legitimacy check (Block G) that flags scams and ghost jobs, and generates tailored ATS-optimized CVs and cover letters. It processes 10+ offers in parallel with sub-agents and tracks everything in a single source of truth.
value: Job seekers (especially mid-to-senior professionals) pay for a subscription that saves them hours by filtering out ghost jobs and low-fit roles, and generates tailored application materials that increase interview rates.
risk: The biggest risk is that LinkedIn or Indeed adds a similar AI filtering feature, making a standalone product redundant; also, the open-source CLI is free, so charging for a wrapper may be a hard sell.
does: career-ops turns any AI coding CLI into a job search command center: it scans job portals (Greenhouse, Ashby, Lever, company pages), evaluates each listing with a structured A-F rubric across 5 weighted dimensions plus a legitimacy check (Block G) that flags scams and ghost jobs, and generates tailored ATS-optimized CVs and cover letters. It processes 10+ offers in parallel with sub-agents and tracks everything in a single source of truth.
why_use: Instead of manually tracking applications in a spreadsheet and guessing which jobs are real, career-ops gives you a structured, AI-powered filter that scores each role 1.0-5.0 and strongly recommends against applying to anything below 4.0. It also researches companies and finds the right person to contact, turning applications into conversations.
gap: The tool is powerful but still requires technical setup and CLI usage, leaving non-technical job seekers underserved.
counter: LinkedIn and Indeed already own job search, and they could add AI scoring overnight; also, the open-source project has 62k stars, so any commercial attempt faces a free, powerful alternative.
differentiator: Package career-ops as a user-friendly web app or desktop app with a guided onboarding that learns your CV and preferences, targeting non-technical job seekers who want the same filtering power without touching a terminal.
hook: Job seekers drowning in hundreds of listings and ghost jobs, wasting hours on applications that never get a reply, need a way to filter for the few roles worth their time before applying.

zh.claim: 求职者被数百个职位列表和幽灵职位淹没，浪费时间在从未回复的申请上，需要一种方法在申请前筛选出少数值得投入的职位。
zh.hook: 求职者被数百个职位列表和幽灵职位淹没，浪费时间在从未回复的申请上，需要一种方法在申请前筛选出少数值得投入的职位。
zh.does: career-ops 将任何 AI 编码 CLI 变成求职指挥中心：它扫描求职门户（Greenhouse、Ashby、Lever、公司页面），使用结构化 A-F 评分（5 个加权维度）评估每个职位，并通过合法性检查（Block G）标记诈骗和幽灵职位，同时生成定制的 ATS 优化简历和求职信。它使用子代理并行处理 10 多个职位，并将所有内容跟踪在单一事实来源中。
zh.why_use: 与其手动在电子表格中跟踪申请并猜测哪些职位是真实的，career-ops 为您提供结构化的 AI 驱动筛选，为每个职位打分（1.0-5.0），并强烈建议不要申请低于 4.0 的职位。它还研究公司并找到合适的联系人，将申请转化为对话。
zh.gap: 当前实现是 CLI 工具，需要技术设置和 AI 编码 CLI，因此只有极客才能使用；没有面向普通求职者的精致产品包装。
zh.counter: LinkedIn 和 Indeed 已经拥有求职市场，它们可以一夜之间添加 AI 评分功能；此外，这个开源项目有 62k 星标，任何商业尝试都面临免费且强大的替代品。
zh.differentiator: 将 career-ops 打包成用户友好的 Web 应用或桌面应用，提供引导式入职，学习您的简历和偏好，面向非技术求职者，让他们无需接触终端即可获得相同的筛选能力。
zh.value: 求职者（尤其是中高级专业人士）为订阅付费，以节省时间，过滤掉幽灵职位和低匹配度职位，并生成定制的申请材料，提高面试率。
zh.risk: 最大的风险是 LinkedIn 或 Indeed 添加类似的 AI 筛选功能，使独立产品变得多余；此外，开源 CLI 是免费的，因此为包装收费可能难以说服用户。
zh.why_good: career-ops 将任何 AI 编码 CLI 变成求职指挥中心：它扫描求职门户（Greenhouse、Ashby、Lever、公司页面），使用结构化 A-F 评分（5 个加权维度）评估每个职位，并通过合法性检查（Block G）标记诈骗和幽灵职位，同时生成定制的 ATS 优化简历和求职信。它使用子代理并行处理 10 多个职位，并将所有内容跟踪在单一事实来源中。

consumer_angle: A simple web app that lets job seekers paste a job description and get a tailored resume and cover letter without any coding.
pick_reason: Strong demand evidence from contributors and forks, but the gap is not fully concrete for a solo founder to build a consumer product quickly.
